MULTISHOT2.name: Multishot
MULTISHOT2.desc:
Release a volley of arrows in a cone in front of you, dealing 94 physical damage (vs. players) / 116 physical damage (vs. mobs).
Slows by 30% for 1s.

GROUNDARROW.name: Ray of Light
GROUNDARROW.desc:
Fire an arrow into the sky, which lands after 0.6s at the targeted position.
Roots all enemies in a 3 radius for 1.8s.
Deals 164 magical damage.

DEADLYSHOT.name: Deadly Shot
DEADLYSHOT.desc:
Shoot an arrow in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies, dealing 80 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Decreases damage resistances by 3% for 5s (stacks up to 3 times).

SPEEDARCHER_KITE.name: Enchanted Quiver
SPEEDARCHER_KITE.desc:
Enchant 4 of your arrows for the next 8s.
While you hold enchanted arrows, your Auto-Attack Speed is increased by 50% and your physical Auto-Attack damage by 2.8.
Each Auto-Attack consumes 1 enchanted arrow.

If an enemy player is in a 6 radius around you, your physical Auto-Attack damage will decrease to ….

Recast the ability within … to dash to targeted position and enchant 3 more arrows (cannot exceed 5 arrows).

PASSIVE_SLOWPOISON.name: Slow Poison
PASSIVE_SLOWPOISON.desc: Each Auto-Attack slows the targeted enemy by 10% (vs. players) / 40% (vs. mobs) for 1s.

JUMPSHOT2.name: Frost Shot
JUMPSHOT2.desc:
Fire an ice arrow 2 in front of you, which explodes in a 4 radius.
Knocks you back by 13.
Deals 46.1 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Slows by 40% for 5s.

POISONARROW.name: Poisoned Arrow
POISONARROW.desc:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 23.4 physical damage.
Poisons the targeted enemy, dealing 56.2 magic damage over 6s (stacks up to 3 times).

SPEEDSHOT2.name: Speed Shot
SPEEDSHOT2.desc:
Release an arrow at the targeted enemy, dealing 25 physical damage.
Resets the cooldown of your weapon's first-slot ability.
Increases your Move Speed by 30% for 2s.

This spell can be recast within 4s.

BURNINGARROWS.name: Explosive Arrows
BURNINGARROWS.desc:
Enchant your next 10 arrows for the next 15s, causing them to explode on impact.
Each explosion deals 23 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius around the targeted enemy (also works for arrows from spells).

PASSIVE_ARMOR_PIERCE_STACK.name: Piercing Arrows
PASSIVE_ARMOR_PIERCE_STACK.desc: Each Auto-Attack decreases the targeted enemy's Defense by 2% for 3s (stacks up to 4 times).

PASSIVE_AASPEEDCHANCE_BOW.name: Auto-Attack Speed
PASSIVE_AASPEEDCHANCE_BOW.desc: Every 5 Auto-Attacks, increase your Auto-Attack Speed by 35% for 5s.

SKILLSHOT_STUN.name: Magic Arrow
SKILLSHOT_STUN.desc:
Shoot a magical arrow in the targeted direction dealing 232 magical damage (vs players) / 283 magical damage (vs mobs).

If the enemy is hit within 6, deal 172 magical damage (vs players) / 202 magical damage (vs mobs) instead.

Hitting an enemy will reduce this ability's cooldown by 2.

ARROWRAIN.name: Rain of Arrows
ARROWRAIN.desc:
Fire volleys of arrows in the air every 0.5s, each landing at the targeted position after 0.5s, while channeling for 2s.
Each volley deals 99 physical damage to all enemies within a 5 radius.
Slows by 20% for 2s.

UNDEADARROWS.name: Undead Arrows
UNDEADARROWS.desc:
Call upon the lost souls around you, increasing your Auto-Attack Range by 35% and Auto-Attack Speed by 30%.
Deals an extra 50 magical damage on every Auto-Attack.

Decreases your Defense by 25%.

The ability can last for up to 8s but can be deactivated earlier.

HELL_ARROW.name: Demon Arrow
HELL_ARROW.desc:
Shoot an arrow infused with demonic power in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals physical damage to enemy players based on the number of enemies the arrow has already hit (the damage can't be reflected).
Deals 391 physical damage to enemy mobs.

Enemies Hit: 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th or more
Damage: 189 | … | … | …

LIGHTNING_ARROW.name: Raging Storm
LIGHTNING_ARROW.desc:
Shoot a storm-infused arrow in the targeted direction, which explodes into a 5 radius stormcloud lasting 5s upon impact with an enemy.
Deals 21 magical damage every 0.3s (this damage cannot be reflected).

Enemies leaving the area will continue to take 147 magical damage over 2.1s (this also happens after the cloud disappears).

Whenever the ability deals damage, it will interrupt the hit enemy's spell casting.

HAWK_SHOT_MULTI1.name: Lucent Hawk
HAWK_SHOT_MULTI1.desc:
Release a Lucent Hawk in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies and dealing 178 magical damage to each enemy hit.

The ability can be recast again within 3s up to 4 times.

AIR_RAID.name: Sky's Fury
AIR_RAID.desc:
Leap to the targeted position and conjure a foothold in the air, becoming Untargetable for up to 3.75s.
Increases your Defense vs. mobs by 9 for 3.75s.

Sky Bolt:
Shoot a lightning-infused arrow at the targeted position, dealing 123 magical damage in a 4 radius to all enemies after 0.4s.

The ability can be recast up to 3 times while Sky's Fury is active, firing a Sky Bolt.
After 3 Sky Bolt casts, Sky's Fury ends.

AUTOFIRE2.name: Auto Fire
AUTOFIRE2.desc:
Focus your attacks on the targeted enemy, dealing 32 physical damage every 0.3s while channeling for up to 1.8s.
The last attack explodes, dealing 82 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius.

BOLTSHOT.name: Explosive Bolt
BOLTSHOT.desc: Fire an explosive bolt at the targeted position, dealing 130 magical damage to all enemies in a 3 radius.

ACID_BOMB.name: Explosive Salvo
ACID_BOMB.desc:
Launch a salvo of explosive bolts at the targeted position, dealing 135 physical damage in a 4.5 radius.
Creates corrosive fumes for 3.5s, decreasing damage resistances by 14%.

SUNDERSHOT.name: Sunder Shot
SUNDERSHOT.desc:
Release a well-aimed bolt at the targeted enemy, dealing 91.4 physical damage.
Decreases damage resistances by 2.7% for every 10% Health the targeted enemy has left (stacks up to 10 times) for 4s.

SNIPESHOT_CROSSBOW.name: Snipe Shot
SNIPESHOT_CROSSBOW.desc:
Snipe the targeted enemy, dealing 386 physical damage.
Decreases damage resistances by 15% for 4s.

PASSIVE_KNOCKBACKCHANCE.name: Forceful Bolts
PASSIVE_KNOCKBACKCHANCE.desc: After every 5 spells cast, your next Auto-Attack knocks back the targeted enemy by 4.

PASSIVE_CD_RESET_Q.name: Well-Prepared
PASSIVE_CD_RESET_Q.desc: After every 4 spells cast, you reset the cooldown of your first-slot ability.

CALTROPS.name: Caltrops
CALTROPS.desc:
Shoot a trap with a 2 radius into the ground at the targeted position, lasting 12s.
The first enemy to step on the trap will activate it, slowing all enemies within a 3 radius by 30% for 3s.
Deals 34 physical damage.
If the trap activates, your Move Speed is increased by 30% for 3s.

KNOCKBACKSHOT2.name: Knockback Shot
KNOCKBACKSHOT2.desc:
Shoot a bolt in the targeted direction, knocking back the first enemy hit by 10.
Deals 62 physical damage.
Hitting an enemy will reduce your Cast Times and will increase your Auto-Attack Speed by 50% for 5s.

SILENCINGBOLT.name: Noise Eraser
SILENCINGBOLT.desc:
Release a bolt in the targeted direction, silencing the first enemy hit for 3.83s on impact.
Deals 146.3 physical damage.

PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_CROSSBOW.name: Furious
PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_CROSSBOW.desc: After every 5 spells cast, increase your damage dealt by 10% for 4s.

CROSSBOW_ARMORPIERCER.name: Sweeping Bolt
CROSSBOW_ARMORPIERCER.desc:
Fire a shredding bolt in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals 225 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Interrupts enemy spell casting.

EXPLODING_SHOT.name: Exploding Shot
EXPLODING_SHOT.desc:
Launch a sticky bomb at the targeted enemy, dealing 50.9 physical damage.
The bomb explodes after 1s, dealing 180 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius (the damage can't be reflected).

GROUNDMINE.name: Explosive Mine
GROUNDMINE.desc:
Plant a mine with a … radius at the targeted position, lasting 12s.
The first player to step on the mine will activate it, dealing 270 magical damage to all enemies in a 7 radius (the damage can't be reflected).

DUAL_RAPIDFIRE.name: Deathward Climax
DUAL_RAPIDFIRE.desc:
Unleash a barrage at the targeted enemy, dealing 30.1 physical damage every 0.3s, while channeling for up to 3.6s.
The damage increases by … for each hit you land (up to 12 times).

CROSSBOW_CONE_ULTIMATE.name: Vicious Barrage
CROSSBOW_CONE_ULTIMATE.desc:
Release a volley of bolts in a cone in front of you every 1s while channeling for 4s.
Increase your Defense by 50%.
Each volley deals 105 magical damage.
Enemy players hit will take 3% of their Current Health as true damage.

CROSSBOW_DIVINE_SHOT.name: Divine Engine
CROSSBOW_DIVINE_SHOT.desc:
Unleash a 26 long beam of Avalonian energy in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies while channeling for 5.2s (can't be interrupted).
Deals 106 magical damage (vs players) / 70 magical damage (vs mobs) every 0.3s.
The beam slowly follows the cursor position.

CRYSTALXBOW.name: Flickershots
CRYSTALXBOW.desc:
Dash to the targeted position, unleashing a barrage of energy bolts in a 8 radius around you.
Deals 81 physical damage.
Gain 35% damage resistances while dashing.

The ability can be recast within 5s up to 3 times, increasing its cooldown by 10s per cast.

CURSEDOT.name: Vile Curse
CURSEDOT.desc:
Curse the targeted enemy, dealing 20.8 magical damage.
Applies one Vile Curse Charge.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals 84.7 magical damage over 10s (stacks up to 4 times).

CURSEBLADE.name: Cursed Sickle
CURSEBLADE.desc:
Shoot a Cursed Sickle in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies. The sickle returns to the cast position after it reaches the full cast range, applying all its effects again.

Deals 20.8 magical damage.
Applies one Vile Curse Charge to each enemy hit.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals 84.7 magical damage over 10s (stacks up to 4 times).

ARMORPIERCER.name: Armor Piercer
ARMORPIERCER.desc:
Release a demonic beam in the targeted direction, dealing 110 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Reduces damage resistances by 17% for 4s.

CURSENOVA.name: Desecrate
CURSENOVA.desc:
Release a desecrated wave in a 4 radius around the targeted position, rooting all enemies hit for 2.6s.
Applies one Vile Curse Charge.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals 84.7 magical damage over 10s (stacks up to 4 times).

DEATHCURSE2.name: Death Curse
DEATHCURSE2.desc:
Place a Death Curse on the targeted enemy after 0.15s, dealing magical damage based on the amount of Vile Curse Charges on the target after 1s (the damage cannot be reflected).

Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
Damage: 157.9 | … | … | … | …

Consumes all Vile Curse Charges on the enemy.

PASSIVE_CURSE.name: Bane
PASSIVE_CURSE.desc: Every 4 Auto-Attacks, cause a demonic explosion around on the targeted enemy, dealing 25 magical damage in a 5 radius.

CURSEDHANDS_STACKUP.name: Grudge
CURSEDHANDS_STACKUP.desc:
Enchant the targeted ally's Auto-Attacks for the next 10s.

Each Auto-Attack deals extra magical damage based on the time the buffed ally has not attacked.

Time: 0s | 0.5s | 1s | 1.5s | 2s
Damage: …CURSEDHANDS_STACKUP_DAMAGE.directattributechange[0].change | … | … | … | …

CURSED_SPLAT.name: Cursed Tar
CURSED_SPLAT.desc:
Create a Cursed Tar puddle with a 3 radius at target location, lasting 4.2s.
Slows all enemies in the puddle by 10%.
Applies one Vile Curse Charge every 1s.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals 84.7 magical damage over 10s (stacks up to 4 times).

CURSEDBEAM.name: Cursed Beam
CURSEDBEAM.desc:
Concentrate a beam of vile energy at the targeted enemy, dealing 48 magical damage every 0.5s, while channeling for 3.5s.

If at least one Vile Curse Charge is active on the target, the beam will consume 1 charge every 2 ticks, dealing 72 magical damage (vs. players) / 58 magical damage (vs. mobs) in a 4 radius instead.

DARKMATTER.name: Dark Matter
DARKMATTER.desc:
Cast an orb of Dark Matter at the targeted enemy.
It then jumps to the closest enemy within 9 of the last enemy hit, dealing 112 magical damage (vs. players) / 56 magical damage (vs. mobs) with each hit (can hit up to 7 targets; can hit the same target multiple times but not twice in a row).

PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_CURSEDSTAFF.name: Furious
PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_CURSEDSTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast, increase your damage dealt by 10% for 4s.

PASSIVE_MOVESPEED_CHANCE_CURSEDSTAFF.name: Hit and Run
PASSIVE_MOVESPEED_CHANCE_CURSEDSTAFF.desc: After every 6 spells cast, your Move Speed increases by 20% for 3s.

AREAOFDECAY.name: Area of Decay
AREAOFDECAY.desc:
Create an Area of Decay with a 0 radius, applying Vile Curse charges every 0.8s, while channeling for 4s.
Purges healing over time effects from all enemies in the area.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals 84.7 magical damage over 10s (stacks up to 4 times).

CURSED_WALL.name: Anguished Soul
CURSED_WALL.desc:
Send an Anguished Soul in the targeted direction, passing through all enemies.
Deals 160 magical damage.
Any enemy hit will be feared for a duration based on the amount of Vile Curse Charges on them.

Charges: 0 | 1| 2 | 3 | 4
Fear Duration: 1.25s | 1.5s | 1.75s | 2s | 2.25s

Consumes up to 2 Vile Curse charges on the enemy.

ENFEEBLEBLADES.name: Enfeeble Blades
ENFEEBLEBLADES.desc:
Summon enfeebling blades, spinning in a 6.5 radius around the targeted location while channeling for 7.5s (cannot be interrupted).
The blades deal 420 magical damage over 3.75s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Purges all buffs of enemies within the area.

SKULLCURSE.name: Haunting Screams
SKULLCURSE.desc:
Summon tortured souls for 5s, haunting the ground in a 6 radius around the targeted position and moving 0 in the targeted direction.
Deals 31 magical damage every 0.5s to all enemies within the area. (the damage can't be reflected)

Players will also take 1.5% of their Max Health as true damage every 0.5s.

CURSEULTIMATE.name: Cataclysm
CURSEULTIMATE.desc:
Curse all enemies within a 0 radius around the targeted position, dealing 144 magical damage over 6s.
Decreases damage resistances by 18% while affected by Cataclysm.

DYNAMIC_CURSE.name: Inner Shadow
DYNAMIC_CURSE.desc:
Reveal the Inner Shadow of the targeted player, dealing damage to all enemies within a 5 radius.

For targets wearing cloth armor:
Lasts for 5.2s.
Deals 66 magical damage (vs. players) / 32 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s (this damage cannot be reflected).

For targets wearing leather armor:
Lasts for 2s.
Deals 40 magical damage (vs. players) / 16.5 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Steals 1 of the Health the enemy has lost.

For targets wearing plate armor:
Slows all enemies within the area by 40% for 2.2s.
After 1.5s, the shadow hits all enemies within the area, dealing 144 physical damage (this damage cannot be reflected).
Reduces the damage resistances of all enemies hit by 30% for 5s.

CURSE_SKELETON_BARF_FDHR.name: Plaguebringer
CURSE_SKELETON_BARF_FDHR.desc:
Conjure a Plaguebringer, knocking back all enemies by 6 (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance), and spreading cursed miasma in the targeted direction.
Deals 161 magical damage.
Negates the target's Healing Received for 2s.

Targets cannot have their Healing Received Negated by Plaguebringer for 6s.

FIRESTAFFBOLT2.name: Fire Bolt
FIRESTAFFBOLT2.desc:
Shoot a fiery bolt at the targeted enemy, dealing 62 magical damage.
Ignites the targeted enemy, dealing 16 magical damage over 4s (stacks up to 5 times).

FIRESTAFFIGNITE2_SPREAD.name: Flame Blast
FIRESTAFFIGNITE2_SPREAD.desc:
Focus fiery energy on the target (enemy, ally or self), igniting all enemies around them in a 5 radius after 1.6s, dealing 140 magical damage.

If the main target is an enemy, they will take 40 magical damage immediately.

If the main target is yourself, increase your move speed by 60% for 1.6s.

FIRESTAFFBOLT_AOE.name: Burning Field
FIRESTAFFBOLT_AOE.desc:
Fire a burning orb at the targeted position, dealing 70 magical damage in a 3 radius.
Sets the ground on fire for 4s.
Deals 55 magical damage (vs players) / 20 magical damage (vs mobs) every 0.5s (this damage cannot be reflected).

PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT.name: Pyroblast
PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT.desc:
Charge up a Pyroblast, while channeling for up to 1.8s.
Deals magical damage upon impact with an enemy within a 4 radius based on how long you have channeled

Time: 0s | 0.6s | 1.2s
Damage: … | … | …

If you channel for 1.8s the Pyroblast will also knock back all enemies hit by 2.5.

PASSIVE_BURN.name: Burn
PASSIVE_BURN.desc: Each Auto-Attack sets the targeted enemy on fire, dealing 25 magical damage over 3s.

FIREWALL.name: Wall of Flames
FIREWALL.desc:
Create a 14 wide firewall in front of you, lasting 5s.
Sets all enemies touching it aflame, dealing 145.4 magical damage over 4s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Enemies set aflame will flee from you for 0.5s (mobs flee only once).

SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL.name: Raging Flare
SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL.desc:
Cast a Flare in the targeted direction, exploding on impact with an enemy.
Deals 205 magical damage in a 5 radius.
Ignites all enemies hit by the explosion, dealing 64.2 magical damage over 3s.

FIRECONE.name: Fire Wave
FIRECONE.desc:
Unleash a cone of fire in front of you, igniting all enemies hit, dealing 173 magical damage over 5s.
Enemies already affected by Fire Bolt, Burning Field or Searing Flame will take an additional 70 magical damage.
Knocks back all enemies hit by 4.

FIREARTILLERY.name: Fire Artillery
FIREARTILLERY.desc:
Throw fiery orbs at the targeted enemy every 1.5s while channeling for 4.5s.

Each orb deals 55 magical damage in a 3 radius.
Leaves a burning patch, igniting all enemies on it for 6s.
Deals 15 magical damage (vs. players) / 5.5 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s (stacks up to 4 times). (This damage cannot be reflected).

SEARING_FLAME.name: Searing Flame
SEARING_FLAME.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5s.

1st, 2nd & 3rd Searing Flame:
Fire a Searing Flame in the targeted direction, dealing 99 magical damage to the first enemy hit.
Ignites the enemy, dealing 44 magical damage over 4s.
Hit at least one enemy to continue the combo.

4th Furious Flame:
Fire a Furious Flame in the targeted direction, dealing 200 magical damage.
Ignites the enemy, dealing 44 magical damage over 4s.

PASSIVE_CASTINGSPEED_CHANCE_FIRESTAFF.name: Aggressive Caster
PASSIVE_CASTINGSPEED_CHANCE_FIRESTAFF.desc: After every 4 spells cast reduce your Cast Times by 40% for 3s.

PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_FIRESTAFF.name: Furious
PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_FIRESTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast, increase your damage dealt by 10% for 4s.

FLAMEPILLAR.name: Flame Pillar
FLAMEPILLAR.desc:
Conjure a flaming pillar with a 4 radius around the targeted position after 0.8s, dealing 200 magical damage to all enemies hit.

Hitting at least one enemy reduces the cooldown of the ability by 50%.

HUMAN_TORCH.name: Combustion
HUMAN_TORCH.desc:
Torch the targeted enemy, dealing 176 magical damage over 5.5s.
The burning enemy and all enemies within a 4 radius will flee from you for 1.5s.
While burning they leave a fiery trail which lasts 4.5s.

The trail deals 26 magical damage (vs. players) / 28 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s (the damage can't be reflected).
Enemies touching the trail will flee from you for 1.5s.

MAGMASPHERE.name: Magma Sphere
MAGMASPHERE.desc:
Release a devastating magma sphere in the targeted direction, rolling through all enemies
Deals 240 magical damage.

Enemy players who are unmounted will take 12% of their Max Health as true damage over 4s (this damage can't be reflected).

METEOR.name: Meteor
METEOR.desc:
Call down a meteor, impacting after 1s at the targeted position.
Deals 434.1 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius (this damage cannot be reflected).
Knocks back all enemies hit by 3.

FLAMETORNADO.name: Flame Tornado
FLAMETORNADO.desc:
Conjures a Flame Tornado with a 5 radius at the targeted position, lasting 5s.
Deals 66 magical damage (vs. players) / 48 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s.

Enemies leaving the area will continue to take 330 magical damage (vs. players) / 240 magical damage (vs. mobs) over 3s (damage can't be reflected).

FIREPHOENIX.name: Flaming Phoenix
FIREPHOENIX.desc:
Summon a Flaming Phoenix that breathes fire over a 0 long area from the targeted position in the targeted direction.
Deals 200 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Sets the ground on fire for 6s.
Enemies within the area take 11 magical damage every 0.5s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Also reduces Healing Received by 40%.

FLAMEDASH.name: Spontaneous Combustion
FLAMEDASH.desc:
Transform into a Fireball, becoming immune to All Effects as you Fly up to 14 towards the targeted position.
Deals 178 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius on impact.
Deals 63 magical damage over 2.25s to all enemies you pass through.

Hitting an enemy player with the impact will reduce this ability's cooldown by 40%.

FROST_BITE.name: Frostbite
FROST_BITE.desc:
Shoot a projectile of concentrated frost in the targeted direction, dealing 102 magical damage upon impact with an enemy.
Applies one Frostbite stack for 3s (stacks up to 3 times).
Stuns enemies with 3 Frostbite stacks for 0.8s.

ICESHARD.name: Ice Shard
ICESHARD.desc:
Drop an ice shard on the targeted position, exploding in a 3 radius on impact.
Deals 130 magical damage (vs. players) / 90 magical damage (vs. mobs) to all enemies hit.

FROSTBOMB_CASTSLOW.name: Frost Bomb
FROSTBOMB_CASTSLOW.desc:
Conjure a Frost Bomb at the targeted position, slowing all enemies within a 5 radius by 30%.
Explodes after 1.6s, dealing 166.1 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius.
Slows all enemies hit by 20% for 5s.

FROSTBEAM.name: Frost Beam
FROSTBEAM.desc:
Release a freezing beam at the targeted enemy, dealing 31.5 magical damage to all enemies within a 4 radius around the target every 0.3s, while channeling for up to 3s.
Decreases Auto-Attack Speed and slows all enemies hit by 15% for each time they take damage (stacks up to 5 times), lasting for 2s after the channel has ended.

FREEZINGWIND.name: Freezing Wind
FREEZINGWIND.desc:
Blow Freezing Wind in a cone in front of you, dealing 200 magical damage on impact.
Roots all enemies hit for 2s.

PASSIVE_FROST.name: Frost
PASSIVE_FROST.desc: After every 4 spells cast, your next Auto-Attack roots the targeted enemy by 0.86s.

FROSTNOVA.name: Frost Nova
FROSTNOVA.desc:
Teleport to the targeted position (can't teleport through obstacles), releasing a Frost Nova with a 3 radius around the starting position.
Stuns all enemies hit for 1s.
Deals 70 magical damage.
Grants immunity to damage for 0.2s.

SHATTER_Q.name: Frozen Surge
SHATTER_Q.desc:
Freeze the ground in front of you along a 16 long and 3.8 wide path, dealing 90 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 20% for 3s.

FROST_LANCE.name: Frost Lance
FROST_LANCE.desc:
Fire a Frost Lance from the targeted position in the targeted direction.
Hitting an enemy causes the lance to explode, dealing 134 magical damage to all enemies within 3 radius.
Decreases damage resistances of all enemies hit by 12% for 3s.

ICE_SCULPTURE.name: Glacial Obelisk
ICE_SCULPTURE.desc:
Conjure a Glacial Obelisk at the targeted position, lasting up to 6s.
Increases all damage and cooldown rate by 20% for up to 10 allies within a 6 radius of the Obelisk.

Recast the ability to detonate the Obelisk early, dealing 77 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 40% for 4s.

The Obelisk will automatically detonate after 6s.

PASSIVE_CASTINGSPEED_CHANCE_FROSTSTAFF.name: Aggressive Caster
PASSIVE_CASTINGSPEED_CHANCE_FROSTSTAFF.desc: After every 4 spells cast reduce your Cast Times by 40% for 3s.

PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_FROSTSTAFF.name: Furious
PASSIVE_SPELLPOWER_CASTER_FROSTSTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast, increase your damage dealt by 10% for 4s.

HAIL_MULTI_1.name: Hail
HAIL_MULTI_1.desc:
Conjure a wave of hail with a 5 radius around the targeted position, which crashes down after 0.4s.
Deals 160 magical damage.
Slows by 10% for 2s.

The spell can be recast within 3s.

ICESTORM2.name: Ice Storm
ICESTORM2.desc:
Summon an ice storm with a 5 radius, moving from the targeted position in the targeted direction for 12 and lasting for 15s.
Deals 72 magical damage (vs. players) / 25 magical damage (vs. mobs) to all enemies within the storm every 0.5s (the damage can't be reflected).
Slows by 30%.

ICEROCK_EXPLODE.name: Avalanche
ICEROCK_EXPLODE.desc:
Launch a giant snowball in the targeted direction, rolling over all enemies.
Deals 160 magical damage (damage cannot be reflected). Knocks back enemy players hit by 10.
Throws enemy mobs in the air for ….

The snowball leaves behind a freezing trail, lasting 4s.
Slows all enemies on it by 40%.

If the snowball collides with terrain it will explode, dealing 160 magical damage (damage cannot be reflected) within a 5 radius.

GLACIALFIELD.name: Frozen Hell
GLACIALFIELD.desc:
Create a blizzard with a 8 radius at the targeted position, lasting 5s.
Deals 22 magical damage to all enemies in it every 1s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Slows by 50% (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).
Slows enemies in the center 3.5 by an additional 30% (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).

FROST_ULTIMATE.name: Ice Crystal
FROST_ULTIMATE.desc:
Create an Ice Crystal with a 0 radius at the targeted position, stunning all enemies hit for 1s.
After the stun, the crystal explodes, dealing 173 magical damage (vs. players) / 253.7 magical damage (vs. mobs) to all enemies within a … radius (the damage can't be reflected).

FROZEN_CRYSTAL.name: Glacial Prison
FROZEN_CRYSTAL.desc:
Create a freezing field in a 6 radius around the target, lasting 3s.
Slows all enemies in it by 30% (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).

Targeting an ally will freeze the target in a crystal immediately for 2s.
Targeting an enemy will freeze the target in a crystal after 1.1s for 2s, if they haven't left the field.
Frozen targets are stunned, immune to damage, and can't be healed.

After the freeze ends, the crystal explodes, dealing 249 magical damage to all enemies within a … radius.

FROST_TARGETED_CHANNEL.name: Arctic Volley
FROST_TARGETED_CHANNEL.desc:
Fire a volley of icicles in the targeted direction every 0.4s, while channeling for 2.4s (can move while channeling).
Each volley deals 76 magical damage in a 4 radius on impact.
Slows by 10% for 1s (stacks up to 6 times).
Costs 2 energy for every volley fired.

ARCANE_CHAIN_MISSILE.name: Chain Missile
ARCANE_CHAIN_MISSILE.desc:
Shoot a Chain Missile in the targeted direction, dealing 132 magical damage to the first enemy hit.
Upon hitting an enemy, it will jump to the closest enemy within 7 of the last enemy hit, dealing 40 magical damage to all following enemies (can hit up to 3 targets; can't hit the same target multiple times).
Applies one Arcane Charge to all enemies hit.

Arcane Charges are consumed whenever you deal direct damage to the affected target, dealing an additional 60 magical damage (Chain Missile damage does not count as direct damage).

SHIELDFRIENDLY.name: Arcane Protection
SHIELDFRIENDLY.desc:
Protect the targeted ally with arcane energy, applying a shield that absorbs up to 300 damage (before resistances) during the next 2s.
Grants immunity to Forced Movement effects.

ENIGMA_BLADE.name: Enigma Blade
ENIGMA_BLADE.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4s.

1st Enigma Blade:
Conjure a magic blade that hits all enemies in a cone in the targeted direction, dealing 190 magical damage.
Hitting at least one enemy enables the next combo ability.

2nd Flicker:
Teleport to the targeted position (cannot teleport through obstacles).
Grants immunity to damage for 0.2s.

CLEANSESPEED2.name: Motivating Cleanse
CLEANSESPEED2.desc:
Purify up to 10 allies in a 4 radius, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced).
Increases the cleansed allies' Move Speed by 40% for 3s.

ARCANEORB2.name: Arcane Orb
ARCANEORB2.desc:
Shoot a sphere of arcane energy in the targeted direction, dealing 73 magical damage in a 6 radius upon impact with an enemy.
Purges all buffs on enemies hit (except for healing over time effects).
Silences enemies for 1.68s (vs players) / 3.36s (vs mobs).

PASSIVE_ATTACKBUFF_ARCANESTAFF.name: Lingering Power
PASSIVE_ATTACKBUFF_ARCANESTAFF.desc: After casting any spell, increase your Auto-Attack Speed by 1.2 and your Auto-Attack Range by 33% for the next 3 Auto-Attacks within 3s.

MAGICSHOCK.name: Magic Shock
MAGICSHOCK.desc:
Release a magic shock, silencing all enemies in a 3 radius for 0.85s.
Deals 150 magical damage to all enemies hit.

FRAZZLE2.name: Frazzle
FRAZZLE2.desc:
Fire arcane energy at the targeted enemy, dealing 125 magical damage.
Decreases Defense by 30% for 4s.

EMPOWERBEAM.name: Empowering Beam
EMPOWERBEAM.desc:
Empower the targeted ally while channeling for 5s (can't be cast on self).
Increases all damage the targeted ally deals by 8% every 0.25s (stacks up to 10 times).

The damage increase lasts for 0.8s after the channel ends.

MIMIC.name: Mimic
MIMIC.desc:
Mimic the targeted player, granting access to a second-slot ability based on the weapon equipped by the target for 20s.

Casting Mimic on an Arcane Staff wielder will grant you access to Magic Shock (the cooldown is independent from the Magic Shock you can select as your first-slot ability).

The ability goes on cooldown if you either cast the mimicked ability or do not cast it while you have access to it.
If you cast the mimicked ability of another weapon, its cooldown is reduced by 20%.

PASSIVE_ARMOR_CASTER_ARCANESTAFF.name: Calmness
PASSIVE_ARMOR_CASTER_ARCANESTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast increase your damage resistances by 24% for 3s.

PASSIVE_SILENCECHANCE.name: Hush
PASSIVE_SILENCECHANCE.desc: After every 5 spells cast your next Auto-Attack silences the targeted enemy for 1.25s.

TIME_FREEZE.name: Time Freeze
TIME_FREEZE.desc:
Freeze time for all enemies within a 5 radius for 2.5s (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).
Targets frozen in time are stunned.
Enemy players frozen in time are also immune to damage and all abilities.
Enemy mobs frozen in time are also immune to all abilities (except ability damage).

Targets cannot be frozen again for 11.5s.

INVULNERABILITY.name: Protective Beam
INVULNERABILITY.desc:
Conjure an arcane shield in a 6.5 radius around the targeted ally, slowing yourself by 30% while channeling for 7s (can't be cast on self).
Absorbs up to 240 damage (before resistances).
Reapplies the shield every 1s, costing 5 Energy.

The shield lasts up to 2s after the channel has ended.

BLACKHOLE.name: Black Hole
BLACKHOLE.desc:
Create a black hole with a 6 radius at the targeted position.
After …, the black hole pulls all enemies within its radius towards its center.
Deals 161.2 magical damage.
Slows by 16% for 5s.

ARCANECORRIDOR.name: Time Corridor
ARCANECORRIDOR.desc:
Create a 25 long corridor of altered time in the targeted direction, lasting for 8s.
Increases Move Speed by 60% and Auto-Attack Speed by 45% for all allies in the corridor.

Slows all enemies in the corridor by 30%.

VOID.name: The Void
VOID.desc:
Summon an entropic bubble with a 2 radius, growing up to 8.5, while channeling for 5s (can't be interrupted).
Cleanses all debuffs (except damage over time effects) and Crowd Control effects of all allies within the bubble.
Increases damage resistances by 30%.

ARCANE_METEOR.name: Dark Sphere
ARCANE_METEOR.desc:
Call down a dark sphere, impacting after 0.4s.
Deals 112 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius.
Applies a Dark Aura on up to 3 enemies hit.

Each Dark Aura has a 5 radius around the affected enemy lasting for 5s.
Decreases healing received by 25% and all damage dealt by 25% (vs players) / by 12% (vs mobs) within the aura.
Slows by 15% (all effects stack up to 3 times).

STARFALL_DOT.name: Starfall
STARFALL_DOT.desc:
Call down a shooting star shower, dealing 63 magical damage in a 8 radius around you every 0.6s, while channeling for up to 7s (cannot be interrupted).
Each 1s channeled costs 4 Energy.

GENEROUSHEAL.name: Generous Heal
GENEROUSHEAL.desc:
Cast a healing prayer on the targeted ally, restoring 100 Health.
Increases Healing Received by 5% for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

SMITE_AOE.name: Smite
SMITE_AOE.desc:
Smite all enemies at the targeted location, dealing 136 magical damage in a 2.5 radius.

The next time an enemy hit takes direct damage within 3s, they will take an additional 38 magical damage.

Hitting at least one enemy will reduce this ability's cooldown by 50%.

PULSINGHEAL.name: Sacred Pulse
PULSINGHEAL.desc:
Release a Sacred Pulse from the targeted ally, restoring 94 Health.

Deals 112 magical damage (vs. players) / 168 magical damage (vs. mobs) in a 5 radius.
Enemy players will be knocked back by 9.
Mobs will be thrown into the air for ….

HEALINGBEAM.name: Holy Beam
HEALINGBEAM.desc:
Focus a Holy Beam at the targeted ally, slowing yourself by 30% while channeling for 3.5s (can't be cast on self).
Restores 50 Health every 0.5s.
The healing increases by … every 0.5s (stacks up to 7 times).

HOLYDESPERATEPRAYER2.name: Desperate Prayer
HOLYDESPERATEPRAYER2.desc:
Cast a Desperate Prayer on the targeted ally, healing the target based on their current Health.

Current Health: above 40% | below 40%
Healing: 100 | 220

If the current Health of your target is above 40%, your Healing Cast is increased by 5% for 15s (stacks up to 3 times).

PASSIVE_HEALPOWERCHANCE.name: Adrenaline Driven Charity
PASSIVE_HEALPOWERCHANCE.desc: After every 4 spells cast, increase your Healing Cast by 20% for 3s.

HOLYFLASH.name: Holy Flash
HOLYFLASH.desc: Conjure a Holy Flash at the targeted position, restoring 106 Health for up to 10 allies in a 5 radius.

HOLYHOT.name: Holy Blessing
HOLYHOT.desc:
Bless the targeted ally, increasing the ally's Armor by 30% and Healing Received by 30% for 4s.
Grants immunity to Forced Movement effects.

HOLYORB.name: Holy Orb
HOLYORB.desc:
Fire a Holy Orb in the targeted direction, which explodes on impact with an ally.
Restores 135 Health for up to 10 allies in a 7 radius.

RESURRECTION.name: Reawaken
RESURRECTION.desc:
Reawaken a knocked-down ally, restoring 30% of the target's Max Health.

Reawakened allies cannot be reawakened again for 180s.

PASSIVE_KNOCKBACK_CASTER_HOLYSTAFF.name: Magic Force
PASSIVE_KNOCKBACK_CASTER_HOLYSTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast, your next Auto-Attack knocks back the targeted enemy by 2.1.

PASSIVE_HOLY_ASCENDED.name: Ascended
PASSIVE_HOLY_ASCENDED.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you cast your weapon's second-slot ability.

Effect:
All your Casts and Channels become uninterruptible for 2s.

HOLYEXPLOSION.name: Holy Explosion
HOLYEXPLOSION.desc:
Release a Holy Explosion in a 7 radius around you, knocking back all enemies hit by 10 (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance).
Heals up to 10 allies for 50 Health every 0.5s, while channeling for up to 2.5s.
Increases the damage resistances of allies hit by the first tick by 16% for 3s.

Each 0.5s channeling costs 4 Energy.

HOLYSHIELD.name: Divine Protection
HOLYSHIELD.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4s (elapsed time before recasting is refunded).

1st Divine Protection:
Give the targeted ally a shield, absorbing up to 456.3 damage (before resistances) for 4s.
As long as the shield remains unbroken, you can cast Divinity's Grace.

2nd Divinity's Grace:
Detonate the shield, releasing a healing pulse that restores 160 Health for up to 10 allies in a 5 radius around the target.

HOLYTOUCH.name: Holy Touch
HOLYTOUCH.desc:
Cover the targeted ally in divine light, healing them for 55 Health every 0.5s, while channeling for up to 3.5s (can be used while stunned or silenced).
Cleanses all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects).
Grants other allies immunity to all Crowd Control effects.
Increases all damage the targeted ally deals by 15%.

HOLY_ULTIMATE.name: Salvation
HOLY_ULTIMATE.desc:
Create a circle of Salvation with a 5.5 radius around the targeted position, charging up for 2s.
Once it is charged, it heals up to 20 allies for 270 Health and makes them immune to further damage for 2s.
Cleanses all Crowd Control, debuffs, and damage over time effects.

CELESTIAL_SPHERE.name: Celestial Sphere
CELESTIAL_SPHERE.desc:
Conjure a bouncing Celestial Sphere at the targeted ally, restoring 77 health for up to 10 allies in a 4 radius.
Bounces to the closest ally within a 11 radius of the last ally hit (can hit up to 8 targets; can hit the same target multiple times, but not twice in a row).

DIVINE_JUMP.name: Divine Intervention
DIVINE_JUMP.desc:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to damage, debuffs, and Crowd Control effects until impact.
Throws all enemies within a 5 radius in the air for ….
Restores 135 Health for up to 10 allies within a 5 radius.

Healing at least one ally reduces this ability cooldown by 25%.

HOLY_DISPEL.name: Sanctify
HOLY_DISPEL.desc:
Sanctify an area at the targeted position, restoring 138 health for up to 20 allies in a 5 radius.
Increases the max and current health of all healed allies by 20% for 3s.
Removes enemy-placed ground-based areas (does not affect areas that exclusively buff or heal).

REJUVENATION.name: Rejuvenation
REJUVENATION.desc:
Renew the targeted ally's strength, applying one Rejuvenation Charge.

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores 73.8 Health over 9s and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 5.3% (stacks up to 3 times).

If the target already has 3 Rejuvenation Charges, all charges will be consumed and you restore 7 Energy.

THORNSAREA.name: Thorn Growth
THORNSAREA.desc:
Conjure a Thorn Growth with a 0 radius at the targeted area, lasting 4s.
Deals 30 magical damage (vs. players) / 24 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s (this damage cannot be reflected).
Whenever the ability deals damage, it will apply one Thorns Charge to all enemies within the growth (stacks up to 5 times).
Slows by 25%.

The ability can be recast again within 3s up to 3 times.

Thorns Charges are consumed by your Auto-Attacks and deal an additional 35 magical damage.

BRAMBLESEED.name: Brambleseed
BRAMBLESEED.desc:
Throw seeds along a 0 long line in targeted direction, dealing 54 magical damage.

After a 0.7s delay brambles will grow along the line, dealing 162 magical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for ….

REANIMATE.name: Revitalize
REANIMATE.desc:
Revitalize the targeted ally, restoring 80 Health and 8 Energy every 1s, while channeling for 4s (taking damage reduces the channel time).
Each 1s channeled costs 4 Energy.

CIRCLEOFLIFE.name: Circle of Life
CIRCLEOFLIFE.desc:
Mend the wounds of up to 15 allies within a 11 radius around you, restoring their Health based on their number of Rejuvenation Charges.

Rejuvenation Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
Health: 107 | 133 | 173 | 227

Any enemies hit with 3 or more Thorn Charges active on them, will be rooted for 2s.
Deals 112 magical damage.

NATURERESILIENCE.name: Protection of Nature
NATURERESILIENCE.desc: Grant nature's protection to a targeted ally, increasing the ally's damage resistances by 20% and Healing Received by 40% for 6s.

REJUVMUSHROOM_GRENADE.name: Rejuvenating Flower
REJUVMUSHROOM_GRENADE.desc:
Plant a magical flower at the targeted position, lasting 20s.

An Ally walking over the flower will consume it, restoring Health and applying Rejuvenation Charges on up to 15 allies within a 5 radius based on how long the flower grew.

Time: 0s | 1.5s | 3s
Healing: 17 | 42 | 71
Rejuvenation Charges: 1 | 2 | 3

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores 73.8 Health over 9s and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 5.3% (stacks up to 3 times).

CLEANSEHEAL.name: Cleanse Heal
CLEANSEHEAL.desc:
Revitalize up to 10 allies in a 4 radius of the targeted position, healing them based on the number of Rejuvenation Charges on them.
Cleanses all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced).

Rejuvenation Charges: 0 | … | … | …
Heal: 65 | … | … | …

Consumes one Rejuvenation Charge from the target.

REJUVENATING_BREEZE.name: Rejuvenating Breeze
REJUVENATING_BREEZE.desc:
Release a Rejuvenating Breeze from the targeted ally, increasing the target's damage resistances by 32% for 2s.
The breeze hits up to 20 allies within a 15 radius around the target.
All allies hit receive the same number of Rejuvenation Charges as the targeted ally has.

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores 73.8 Health over 9s and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 5.3% (stacks up to 3 times).

PASSIVE_ARMOR_CASTER_NATURESTAFF.name: Calmness
PASSIVE_ARMOR_CASTER_NATURESTAFF.desc: After every 5 spells cast increase your damage resistances by 24% for 3s.

PASSIVE_MOVESPEED_CHANCE_NATURESTAFF.name: Hit and Run
PASSIVE_MOVESPEED_CHANCE_NATURESTAFF.desc: After every 6 spells cast, increase your Move Speed by 20% for 3s.

BRIEROFLIFE.name: Living Armor
BRIEROFLIFE.desc:
Protect the targeted ally with Living Armor, restoring 66 Health and increasing their damage resistances by 13% for 4s.
Whenever the target receives direct damage, they will restore 40 Health.

WELLOFLIFE2.name: Well Of Life
WELLOFLIFE2.desc:
Create a Well of Life with a 7 radius at the targeted position, lasting 4s.
Heals up to 20 allies within the Well for 69 Health every 1s.

NATURE_ULTIMATE_SINGLE.name: Spiritual Seed
NATURE_ULTIMATE_SINGLE.desc:
Plant a Spiritual Seed in the targeted ally, healing the target for 208.5 Health after 1s.

The ability can be recast again within 2.5s up to 2 times, increasing its cooldown to 20s and 30s.

Stacking Spiritual Seed twice on the same target will override the first cast.

ROTTENVINES.name: Elevated Nature
ROTTENVINES.desc:
Conjure an aura with a 9 radius, increasing your Move Speed by … while channeling for up to 6.4s (can't be interrupted).
Restores 33 Health (when used alone) / 39 Health (when healing at least one ally) every 0.8s for up to 10 allies.

SPIRITANIMAL.name: Spirit Animal
SPIRITANIMAL.desc:
Release a Spirit Animal from the targeted position in the targeted direction that heals any ally touching it by 110 and cleansing all damage over time effects, creating a … long trail that lasts for 9s.
Heals up to 20 allies standing on the trail every 1s for 14 Health.
For each ally standing on the trail, the healing is increased by 25%.

SOUL_LINK.name: Soul Link
SOUL_LINK.desc:
Bind the souls of two targets together, linking them for 5s.

If 2 allies are linked:
Redirects 50% of the damage taken by one target to the other target.
Transfers 75% of the Healing Received by one target to the other target.

If an ally and an enemy are linked:
Redirects 50% of the Healing Received by the enemy to the ally.
Redirects 10% of the damage the ally takes to the enemy.

If 2 enemies are linked:
Deals 50% of the damage one target takes (after damage resistances) to the other target as true damage.

DUAL_NATURE.name: Dual Nature
DUAL_NATURE.desc:
Gather ambient magic, affecting up to 10 targets in a 7 radius around you for 8s.
While the ability is active, recasting invokes the opposing ability.

Fortify:
Grants a 171 damage shield for 1.5s.
Restores 32 Health to allies every 0.85s.
Increases your Healing Cast by 15%.

Ensnare:
Roots enemies for 2.25s (enemies cannot be Rooted by you again).
Increases allies' Damage by 15%.

SUNDERARMOR2.name: Sunder Armor
SUNDERARMOR2.desc:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 66.7 physical damage.
Applies one Sunder Armor Charge.

Each Sunder Armor Charge decreases damage resistances by 4% (vs players) / 6% (vs mobs) for 8s (stacks up to 3 times).

QDASH.name: Deadly Swipe
QDASH.desc:
Leap towards the targeted position, dealing 75 physical damage to all enemies in a 3 radius.
Applies one Assassin Spirit on you for every enemy hit.

Hitting at least one enemy will restore 6 Energy.

Each Assassin Spirit Charge increases all your damage by 6% for 8s (stacks up to 3 times).

THROWINGBLADES.name: Throwing Blades
THROWINGBLADES.desc:
Throw three Throwing Blades in a cone in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies and dealing 60 physical damage.
Increases your Move Speed by 15%, and all damage you deal by 10%, for each unique enemy hit (stacks up to 3 times) for 5s.

GROUNDDASH.name: Dash
GROUNDDASH.desc:
Dash towards the targeted position.
Increases all damage you deal by 15% for 4s.

BLOODTHIRSTYBLADE.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
BLOODTHIRSTYBLADE.desc:
Give in to your Bloodthirsty Blade, dealing an additional 50 magical damage (vs. players) / 30 magical damage (vs. mobs) with each Auto-Attack.
Steals 1 of the Health the enemy has lost through the bonus damage.
Increases your Move Speed by 30%.

Deals 4% of your Max Health as true damage to yourself every 1s.

The ability lasts up to 6s but can be deactivated earlier.

PASSIVE_BLEEDCHANCE.name: Deep Cuts
PASSIVE_BLEEDCHANCE.desc: Every 4 Auto-Attacks, inflict a bleed on the target enemy dealing 16.7 physical damage over 2s.

PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_DAGGER.name: Life Leech
PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_DAGGER.desc: Every Auto-Attack steals 15% of the Health the enemy has lost.

DEEPCUTS.name: Forbidden Stab
DEEPCUTS.desc:
Attack the targeted enemy, interrupting the target's spell casting.
Deals 84.3 physical damage.
Negates the target's Healing Received for 1.5s.

ASSASSINSPIRIT.name: Assassin Spirit
ASSASSINSPIRIT.desc:
Invoke your Assassin Spirit, applying an Assassin Spirit Charge on you every 2s.

Decreases your Defense by 4%.

The ability can last up to 15s but can be deactivated earlier.

Each Assassin Spirit Charge increases all your damage by 6% for 8s (stacks up to 3 times).

SKILLSHOT_TELEPORT.name: Shadow Edge
SKILLSHOT_TELEPORT.desc:
Throw a knife in the targeted direction, stunning the first enemy hit for 1s.
Hitting an enemy will pull you behind the hit enemy making you immune to all Crowd Control effects, and Debuffs until arrival.

Hitting a player reduces this ability's cooldown by 25%.

CHAINDASH.name: Chain Slash
CHAINDASH.desc:
Charge towards the targeted enemy, hitting the target and then charging to the closest enemy within 7 of the enemy you hit last (up to 3 different targets), dealing more physical damage with each consecutive hit.
Turns you invisible and grants immunity to damage while charging.

Enemy Hit: 1 | 2 | 3
Damage: 110 | … | …

SOULSHAKER.name: Soul Shaker
SOULSHAKER.desc:
Shake the ground along a 20 long line in the targeted direction, dealing 125 physical damage.

Leaves behind a wall of energy that lasts 3.5s, rooting all unmounted enemies who touch it for its duration.
Mounted enemies are rooted for 2s instead.

The spell can be recast again within 5s, increasing its cooldown by 20s.

QS_CRYSTAL_COMBO.name: Phantom Twin
QS_CRYSTAL_COMBO.desc:
Combine up to … abilities. The combo resets after 5s

1st & 2nd Phantom Twin:
Summon a projection for 2s, slashing around itself in a 5 radius at the targeted position and moving 6 away from you.
Deals 46 physical damage every 0.4s within the radius (damage cannot be reflected).
Slows by 15%.

3rd Phantom Slash:
Slam the ground in a 0 radius around the targeted position in sync with a projection, throwing all enemies hit in the air for ….
Deals 131 physical damage.

HAMMER_SHOVE.name: Powerful Swing
HAMMER_SHOVE.desc:
Step in the targeted direction and swing your hammer in a cone in front of you, dealing 147 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Knocks back up to 10 enemy mobs  by ….
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 66.

THREATENINGSTRIKE_HAMMER.name: Threatening Strike
THREATENINGSTRIKE_HAMMER.desc:
Strike the targeted enemy, dealing 100 physical damage.
Increases your Threat Generation by 4 for 3s.

HAMMER_TREMOR.name: Seismic Tremor
HAMMER_TREMOR.desc:
Smash your hammer repeatedly into the ground at the target position, dealing physical damage, while channeling for 1.4s.
The damage and radius is based on how long you have channeled.

Channel Time: 0.4s | 0.8s | 1.4s
Damage: 88 | 88 | 185
Radius: 3 | 3 | 5

CHARGESLOWAE.name: Slowing Charge
CHARGESLOWAE.desc:
Dash towards the targeted position, dealing 56.4 physical damage to all enemies you pass through.
Slows by 50% for 4s.

HAMMERWHIRLWIND2.name: Earth Shatter
HAMMERWHIRLWIND2.desc:
Shatter the earth in a 5.5 radius around you, dealing 66.6 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Stuns for 2.25s.
Makes you the highest-priority target for all mobs hit.

PASSIVE_STUNCHANCE.name: Stunning Strike
PASSIVE_STUNCHANCE.desc: Every 5 Auto-Attacks, stun the targeted enemy for 0.43s.

GEYSER.name: Power Geyser
GEYSER.desc:
Hit the ground, releasing a Power Geyser with a 3 radius at the targeted position after 0.4s.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for ….
Deals 55 magical damage.

Knocks back all allies hit 8 away from the geyser.

KNOCKOUT.name: Knockout
KNOCKOUT.desc:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 56.7 physical damage.
Puts the target to sleep for 5s (vs. players) / 10s (vs. mobs). (Taking damage wakes the enemy up.)

IRONBREAKER.name: Iron Breaker
IRONBREAKER.desc:
Slam your hammer on the ground, dealing 90 physical damage (vs players) / 120 physical damage (vs mobs) to all enemies in a 2.5 radius around the targeted position.
Reduces damage resistances by 12% for 4s.
Breaks any shields active on all enemies hit.

TAR_RING.name: Inertia Ring
TAR_RING.desc:
Create a … thick ring in a 6.5 radius around you, lasting 4s.
Slows enemies passing through the ring by 80% (ignoring Crowd Control resistance).

PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_HAMMER.name: Life Leech
PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_HAMMER.desc: Every Auto-Attack steals 15% of the Health the enemy has lost.

PASSIVE_CCDURATION_CHANCE_HAMMER.name: Dreadladen Fighting
PASSIVE_CCDURATION_CHANCE_HAMMER.desc: Every 4 Auto-Attacks, increase the duration of your Crowd Control effects by 35% for 2s.

GROUNDBREAKER2.name: Groundbreaker
GROUNDBREAKER2.desc:
Split the earth in a 20 long line in front of you, dealing 46 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Enemies at the center of the split earth will be stunned for 2.7s.

HAMMERTACKLE.name: Tackle
HAMMERTACKLE.desc:
Dash toward the targeted position, knocking back all enemies you pass through by 2 and stunning them for 2.35s.
Deals 73 physical damage.

Each enemy player hit reduces this ability's cooldown by … (up to … times).

UNDEADHAND.name: Grasp of the Undead
UNDEADHAND.desc:
Summon a giant undead hand at the targeted position, stunning all enemies within a 2.5 radius for 2.48s after 0.35s.
Deals 100 physical damage.
Decreases max and current Health by 10% for 3s.

GIANTSTEPS.name: Giant Steps
GIANTSTEPS.desc:
Grow to giant size, increasing your damage resistances by 30% and your Auto-Attack Range by 50% for 10s.
Creates an aura with a 7 radius around you, slowing all enemies in it by 35%.

While the ability is active, you can cast Giant Smash multiple times by recasting the ability.

Giant Smash:
Slam your hammers on the ground, dealing 125 physical damage to all enemies in a 4 radius around the targeted position.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for ….

RAM_CHARGE.name: Ground Pound
RAM_CHARGE.desc:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects and damage until impact.
Stuns all enemies in a 5.5 radius for 2.5s.
Deals 98.3 physical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for a duration based on the number of enemies hit (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance and duration modifiers).

Enemies Hit Thresholds: 1 | 4 | 7
Duration: … | … | …

SPINNING_SMASH.name: Onslaught
SPINNING_SMASH.desc:
Spin towards the targeted position, whirling your hammer in a 3.5 radius around you for 1.2s.
Pulls up to 10 enemies you pass through along with you, stunning them for 0.8s.
Deals 27 physical damage every 0.2s.

Upon reaching the targeted position, slam your hammer on the ground after 0.5s, throwing all enemies within a 5 radius into the air for ….
Deals 112 physical damage.

CRYSTALWAVE.name: Hyperstatic
CRYSTALWAVE.desc:
Smash the ground in front of you, opening a vein of charged magical energy.

Allies in the area gain a Shield, absorbing up to 350 damage (before resistances) for up to ….

Deals 90 Magical Damage to enemies.
Applies one Static stack for 6s.
Enemies gain one additional Static stack whenever they receive direct damage.
Stuns enemies with 5 Static stacks for 3.2s.

DEFENSIVESLAM.name: Defensive Slam
DEFENSIVESLAM.desc:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 60 physical damage.
Increases damage resistances by 15% and Crowd Control Resistance by 20% for 4s for you and up to 10 allies in a 8 radius

GROUNDSHAKER.name: Ground Shaker
GROUNDSHAKER.desc:
Hit the ground in a 4 radius around the targeted position, dealing 219 physical damage.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for ….

THREATENINGSMASH.name: Threatening Smash
THREATENINGSMASH.desc:
Swing your mace in a cone in front of you, dealing 142 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 100.

CHARGE_ROOT.name: Snare Charge
CHARGE_ROOT.desc:
Leap towards the targeted position, dealing 53.2 physical damage to all enemies in a 6 radius on impact.
Roots all enemies hit for 2.56s (vs players) / 5.11s (vs mobs).
Interrupts enemies' spell casting.

MACELEAP.name: Deep Leap
MACELEAP.desc:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects, Debuffs, and damage until impact.
Deals 203 physical damage in a 5 radius on impact.
Slows all enemies hit by 30% for 3s.
Enemies within 3 radius will be stunned for 1.8s.

GUARDRUNE.name: Guard Rune
GUARDRUNE.desc:
Conjure a Guard Rune with a 5 radius around the targeted position, which lasts 5s.
Increases the damage resistances of up to 10 allies within it by 6% and makes them immune to Forced Movement effects and Stuns.

PBAOE_PULL.name: Air Compressor
PBAOE_PULL.desc:
Create a vacuum in a 7 radius around you, pulling all enemies towards you after 1.5s.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 205.6.

Slows yourself by 30% for 2.5s.

SACRED_GROUND.name: Sacred Ground
SACRED_GROUND.desc:
Create a sacred circle with a 3 radius that lasts 3s.
Silences and slows all enemies inside by 20%

Mobs will become immune to the silence after 3s.

PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_MACE.name: Life Leech
PASSIVE_HEALTHCHANCE_MACE.desc: Every Auto-Attack steals 15% of the Health the enemy has lost.

PASSIVE_CCDURATION_CHANCE_MACE.name: Dreadladen Fighting
PASSIVE_CCDURATION_CHANCE_MACE.desc: Every 4 Auto-Attacks, increase the duration of your Crowd Control effects by 35% for 2s.

SHRIEKMACE.name: Battle Howl
SHRIEKMACE.desc:
Summon a magic circle with a 6 radius, silencing all enemies hit for 2.33s and Purging all buffs from them.
Affected mobs will have their Auto-Attack Damage reduced by 40% for 4s.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 156.

ROOTFIELD.name: Gravitas
ROOTFIELD.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5s.

1st Close In:
Dash towards the targeted position.

2nd Gravitas:
Conjure a high gravity field with a 5 radius around you, rooting all enemies (ignoring crowd control resistance), while channeling for up to 5s (can't be interrupted).
At the end of the channel enemies will remain rooted for 1.5s.

Hitting less than 3 enemy players will end the root after 1.5s (mobs are unaffected by this condition).

PRIMALSLAM.name: Force of Nature
PRIMALSLAM.desc:
Split the earth in a 18 long line in front of you, releasing air jets that last for 4s.
Deals 100 magical damage on impact.
Knocks back enemy players touching the air jets by 18.
Throws enemy mobs in the air for ….

Increases your Threat by 200 towards any mob within a 5 radius around you.

SHRINKINGSMASH.name: Shrinking Curse
SHRINKINGSMASH.desc:
Wind up for 0.6s to perform a shrinking smash in a cone in front of you.
Decreases max and current Health of all enemies hit by 20% for 8s.
Decreases damage dealt by 40% (vs. players) / 25% (vs. mobs) for 8s.
Decreases Healing Cast by 40% for 8s.
Deals 98.3 magical damage.

VACUUMSLASH.name: Vendetta
VACUUMSLASH.desc:
Shoot a shockwave in the targeted direction, cursing the first enemy hit.
Pulls all enemies in a 8 radius toward the cursed enemy after 1.2s.
Stuns for 0.8s.
Deals 62 magical damage.

BLESSED_MACES.name: Blessed Aurora
BLESSED_MACES.desc:
Conjure a … wide blessed aurora lasting 3s.
Increases Move Speed for up to 20 allies passing through the aurora by 30% for 5s.
Applies a shield that absorbs up to 400 damage (before resistances) while Move Speed is increased.

Bless your maces, restoring 50 Health for you and up to 10 allies in a 8 radius around you with every Auto-Attack within the next 5s.

MACE_CRYSTAL_FRAGMENT_STORM.name: Eye of the Storm
MACE_CRYSTAL_FRAGMENT_STORM.desc:

1st & 2nd Dreadstorm Sweep:
Swing your weapon in a cone in front of you, dealing 50 physical damage to all enemies hit.
If you hit at least one enemy, gain one Eye of the Storm charge.

3rd Dreadstorm Surge:
Smash the ground in front of you, dealing 109 physical damage in a 4 radius.
Casting this ability grants you one Eye of the Storm charge.

Eye of the Storm:
Become the center of a storm that grows in size based on your Eye of the Storm charges, lasting 5s.
Reduces damage resistances of all enemies in the storm by 18% and slows them by 25%.

Eye of the Storm Charges: 1 | 2 | 3
Eye of the Storm Radius: 6 | 7.5 | 9

CREATE_OPENING.name: Create Opening
CREATE_OPENING.desc:

Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 80 physical damage.

2nd Exploit Opening:
Deals 80 physical damage.

DASHKICK.name: Dragon Leap
DASHKICK.desc:

1st Dragon Leap:
Dash towards the targeted position and kick all enemies, dealing 95 physical damage within a 2.5 radius.
Hitting at least one enemy enables the next combo ability.

2nd Dragon Punch:
Leap towards the targeted position.
Deals 70 physical damage to all enemies within a 2.5 radius.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for ….

TRIPLE_KICK.name: Triple Kick

Dash towards the targeted position, repeatedly kicking all enemies you pass through.
Deals 37 physical damage (vs. players) / 85 physical damage (vs. mobs) up to three times.
Pulls up to 1 enemy player along with you.

BACKHAND_KNOCKBACK.name: Backhand Strike
BACKHAND_KNOCKBACK.desc:

Knocked-back enemies that collide with the environment receive an additional 100 physical damage.
Damage resistances will be decreased by 20% for 5s.

BLAZING_GEYSER.name: Blazing Geyser
BLAZING_GEYSER.desc:
Hit the ground, releasing a Blazing Geyser with a 4 radius in front of you.
Deals 188 magical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for ….

Hitting at least one enemy will reset the cooldown of your first-slot ability.

PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_BRAWLER.name: Fatal Fury
PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_BRAWLER.desc:
Every Auto-Attack, your damage increases by 2% for 3s (Stacks up to 9 times).

On max stacks the buff can't be refreshed and will run out.

PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_RAGE.name: Rage
PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_RAGE.desc:
Condition:
Activates every time you take damage when your Health is below 40%.

Effect:
Increases your damage by 15% and your Cooldown Modifier by 15% for 3s.

CROSSSTEP_ROUNDHOUSE.name: Fleet Footwork
CROSSSTEP_ROUNDHOUSE.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 2s.

1st Roundhouse Kick:
Kick all enemies in a cone in the targeted direction, dealing 78 physical damage.

2nd Cross Step:
Dash towards the targeted position, increasing your damage resistances by 20% while dashing.
Increases your Auto-Attack Damage by 1.3 for 5s.

KNUCKLE_COUNTER.name: Counter
KNUCKLE_COUNTER.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4s.

1st Counter:
Enter a counter-stance while channeling for up to 0.2s (can't be interrupted).
Increase your Defense by 3 for 2s.
Reflects 1.5 of incoming damage as magical damage.
If you take direct damage during that time, mark the first attacker, and enable the next combo ability.

2nd Follow Through:
Dash to the marked enemy, dealing 122 physical damage in a 4 radius.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for ….

SHOCKWAVE_PUNCH.name: Shockwave
SHOCKWAVE_PUNCH.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 2.5s.

1st Shockwave:
Shoot a Shockwave in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals 117 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Hitting at least one enemy enables the next combo ability.

2nd Rushdown:
Dash to the first enemy hit by the Shockwave.

KNUCKLECOMBO.name: Devastating Combo
KNUCKLECOMBO.desc:
Execute a two-punch combo on the targeted enemy while channeling for 1.6s (can't be interrupted).

The first punch deals 30 physical damage.
Stuns for 1.1s.

The second punch deals 153 physical damage.
Knocks the target back by 3.

PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_RUSHDOWN.name: Rushdown
PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_RUSHDOWN.desc: Every Auto-Attack, your Move Speed increases by 30% for 2s.

PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_COMBOBREAKER.name: Hard to Catch
PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_COMBOBREAKER.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you cast your weapon's second-slot ability.

Effect:
Increases your damage resistances by 20% and your Crowd Control Resistance by 1 for 3s.

DIVEPUNCH_RISE.name: Falcon Smash
DIVEPUNCH_RISE.desc:
Float into the air and become immune to all Crowd Control effects for up to 3s.

Recast the ability to dive towards the targeted position.
Deals physical damage within a 6 radius upon impact based on the distance of the enemy from the targeted position.

Distance: 4 | 6

PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_BRAWLER_SPEED.name: Fatal Fury
PASSIVE_KNUCKLE_BRAWLER_SPEED.desc:
Every Auto-Attack, your damage increases by 1.5% for 3s (Stacks up to 12 times)

On max stacks the buff can't be refreshed and will run out.

IMPULSE_PUNCH.name: Gravitational Collapse
IMPULSE_PUNCH.desc:
Unleash a powerful punch in a cone in front of you, dealing magical damage and slowing all enemies hit for 2s based on the type of armor the enemy is wearing.

Armor: Plate or Mobs | Leather | other
Damage: ……$IMPULSE_PUNCH_CLOTH.directattributechange[0].change
Slow: 75% | 50% | 25%

Enemies hit become immune to another Collapse for 1s.

PUMMELING_STRIKES.name: Hundred Striking Fists
PUMMELING_STRIKES.desc:
Release a flurry of fists in a cone in front of you while channeling for up to 3s (can't be interrupted).
Deals 36 physical damage (vs players) / 24 physical damage (vs mobs) every 0.5s.
The cone slowly follows the cursor position.

2s after the last Striking Fist hits, the enemy will take an additional 30 magical damage for each hit they received (stacks up to 10 times, damage can't be reflected).

BOULDER_TOSS.name: Infernal Boulder
BOULDER_TOSS.desc:
Throw a boulder towards the targeted area, which bounces three times as it rolls. Each impact will reduce in damage and radius.

Boulder Bounces: 1st | 2nd | 3rd
Radius: 0 | 0 | 0
Damage: 177 | 126 | 76

Each impact also sets all enemies hit on fire, dealing 54 magical damage over 3s.
Reduces Healing Received by 20% (stacks up to 3 times).

GROWING_PUNCH.name: Earth Crusher
GROWING_PUNCH.desc:
Charge up the Earth Crusher, slowing yourself by 25% while channeling for up to 2.5s (can't be interrupted).

Deals magical damage to all enemies in an area around you.
The damage and radius is based on how long you have channeled (this damage cannot be reflected; you may end the channel early).

Charge Up Time: 0.5s | 1s | 1.5s | 2s
Damage: 165 | 175 | 185 | 195
Radius: 5 | 7 | 8 | 9

Channeling for the full duration will throw all enemies hit in the air for ….

TRIPLECOMBO_DIVEKICK.name: Purifying Combination
TRIPLECOMBO_DIVEKICK.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5s.

1st Dive Kick:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects until impact.
Throws enemies in the air for ….
Deals 43 physical damage.

Punch the area in front of you, dealing 232 physical damage.
Purges all buffs from all enemies hit (except for healing over time effects).

CONEPUNCH2.name: Unstoppable Rush
CONEPUNCH2.desc:
Dash to a targeted enemy, releasing a Pulse of raw energy, dealing 43 magical damage.
Decreases Max and Current Health by 3% for 5s (stacks up to 5 times).
Gain 3 Pulse Charges for the next 3s.

Pulse Charges release an additional Pulse with each Weapon ability or Auto-Attack.

The ability can be recast within 5s, increasing its cooldown by 30s (elapsed time before recasting is refunded).

VANITY_SUMMONING_PORTAL.name: Portal
VANITY_SUMMONING_PORTAL.desc:
Creates a portal to another dimension. You can't enter it from this side, but beware of creatures entering our dimension from the other side.

Energy Cost: …castrange
Cooldown: $recastdelay

SHAPE_Q_CAST.name: Unstable Projectile
SHAPE_Q_CAST.desc:
Shoot a projectile of unstable energy at target enemy, dealing 72 magical damage to the target and shattering in a cone behind them.
Deals 44 magical damage to all enemies hit by the cone.
Applies one Shift Charge on you.

SHAPE_Q_SKILLSHOT.name: Reality Fissure
SHAPE_Q_SKILLSHOT.desc:

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you and continue the combo.

2nd Reality Fissure

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you and continue the combo.

SHAPE_W_DAMAGE_AOE.name: Distortion
SHAPE_W_DAMAGE_AOE.desc:

SHAPE_W_AREA_PULL.name: Positional Drift
SHAPE_W_AREA_PULL.desc:

Deals 85 magical damage to all enemies hit.

Each enemy hit applies one Shift Charge on you (up to 2 times).

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).

SHAPESHIFT_PANTHER.name: Shadow Panther Transformation
SHAPESHIFT_PANTHER.desc:
Transform into a Shadow Panther for up to 12s.
This changes your abilities and stats.
Offensive: high
Defensive: low
Energy Regeneration: very high

On the Prowl
If no enemies are within in a 9 radius around you for 1s, you will turn invisible to players, but reduce your Movement Speed by 30%.
While invisible, enemies within in a 25 radius will be alerted.

PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_ATTACK_BUFF.name: Altered Beast
PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_ATTACK_BUFF.desc: When transforming, you increase your Max and Current Health by 2% for 5s for each Shift Charge (stacks up to 5 times).

PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_Q_CAST_DAMAGE_REDUCE.name: Intimidating Presence
PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_Q_CAST_DAMAGE_REDUCE.desc:
Whenever you hit an enemy with a Q-Ability in human form, decrease their damage by 3% for 7s (stacks up to 3 times).
Increase your Threat Generation against mobs by 1.

SHAPE_Q_DAMAGE_AND_SHIELD.name: Adapting Matter
SHAPE_Q_DAMAGE_AND_SHIELD.desc:
Unleash unstable energy at the target position, dealing 70 magical damage to enemies.
Applies a shield to yourself and up to 5 allies that absorbs 150 damage for 2s.

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you.
Hitting at least one ally will apply one Shift Charge on you.

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).

SHAPE_W_TETHERBEAM.name: Tether Shift
SHAPE_W_TETHERBEAM.desc:
Attach a tether to an unmounted target (cannot be cast on self).

Attaching to an ally:
Applies a shield that absorbs 300 damage for 2s.
If the ally is a guild, alliance or party member, pull them to your position.

Attaching to an enemy:
Dash towards the attached enemy.
Applies a shield to yourself that absorbs 100 damage for 2s.

SHAPE_Q_CONE_MELEE.name: Pulse Shock
SHAPE_Q_CONE_MELEE.desc:
Cast a shockwave in front of you, dealing 97 magical damage.
Decreases damage resistances by 2% for 6s (stacks up to 3 times).
Each enemy hit applies one Shift Charge on you (up to 2 times).

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).

SHAPE_W_POLYMORPH.name: Polymorph
SHAPE_W_POLYMORPH.desc:
Shoot an energy orb in the targeted direction, transforming the first unmounted, not transformed player hit into a helpless animal for 2.5s.
Hitting a mob or transformed player will decrease their max and current Health by 15% for 5s instead.
The affected player becomes immune to Polymorph's non damage effects for 5s.

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you.

PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_GATHER_CHARGES.name: Innate Power
PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_GATHER_CHARGES.desc:
After dealing damage in human form, apply one Shift Charge on you every 5s for ….

PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_W_CAST_SPEED_BUFF.name: Rule Bender
PASSIVE_SHAPESHIFT_W_CAST_SPEED_BUFF.desc: After casting a second-slot ability in human form, increase your Auto-Attack Speed and Cast Speed by 30% for 5s.

SHAPESHIFT_ENT.name: Sylvian Transformation
SHAPESHIFT_ENT.desc:

Growth

Enrage

SHAPESHIFT_ROCK_ELEMENTAL.name: Runestone Golem Transformation
SHAPESHIFT_ROCK_ELEMENTAL.desc:

Health Increase: 10% | 15% | 20% | 25% | 30%

SHAPESHIFT_AVALONIAN_EAGLE.name: Dawnbird Transformation

Transform into a Dawnbird for up to 20s.

Airborne

SHAPESHIFT_CRYSTAL_COBRA.name: Crystal Cobra Transformation
SHAPESHIFT_CRYSTAL_COBRA.desc:

Energy Regeneration: very high

Slippery

PASSIVE_CAPE_BRIDGEWATCH.name: Sandstorm
PASSIVE_CAPE_BRIDGEWATCH.desc:

PASSIVE_CAPE_FORTSTERLING.name: Untouchable
PASSIVE_CAPE_FORTSTERLING.desc:

Activates when you get stunned, silenced, transformed, or rooted.

Effect:
Become untouchable, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects).

PASSIVE_CAPE_LYMHURST.name: Energy Reserve
PASSIVE_CAPE_LYMHURST.desc:

Tap into your Energy Reserve, restoring 70% of your Max Energy over 10s.

PASSIVE_CAPE_MARTLOCK.name: Shield of Protection
PASSIVE_CAPE_MARTLOCK.desc:

PASSIVE_CAPE_THETFORD.name: Chain Lightning
PASSIVE_CAPE_THETFORD.desc:
Condition:

Release Chain Lightning at the targeted enemy, which jumps to the closest enemy within 9 of the last enemy hit, dealing 92 magical damage with each hit (can hit up to 4 targets; can't hit the same target twice).

PASSIVE_CAPE_CAERLEON.name: Opportunist
PASSIVE_CAPE_CAERLEON.desc:
Condition:

Exploit a small window of opportunity, resetting the cooldown of your weapon's first-slot ability.

PASSIVE_CAPE_FEY.name: Fey Barrier
PASSIVE_CAPE_FEY.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you cast your head slot spell.

Applies a shield that absorbs up to 275 damage (before resistances) during the next 4s.
Grants you immunity to purges while the shield is active.

PASSIVE_CAPE_AVALON.name: Force Pulse
PASSIVE_CAPE_AVALON.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you do an Auto-Attack.

Effect:
Collect energy at your core for 0.5s and unleash it at the end dealing 133 magical damage to enemies in a 6 radius around you.
Reduces damage of enemies hit by 15% for 4s.

PASSIVE_CAPE_SMUGGLER.name: Hidden Vial
PASSIVE_CAPE_SMUGGLER.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you cast your potion slot ability.

Effect:
Grab a hidden potion, reducing the cooldown of your potion slot ability by 80.

PASSIVE_CAPE_HERETIC.name: Devious Trap
PASSIVE_CAPE_HERETIC.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you cast your shoe slot spell.

Effect:
Drop 3 traps with a … radius below your feet and to the sides of you, which lasts up to 5s.
The first enemy to step on a trap will activate it and become rooted for 6s.
Deals 60 physical damage.

PASSIVE_CAPE_UNDEAD.name: Vanisher
PASSIVE_CAPE_UNDEAD.desc:
Condition:
Activates when your Health drops below 15%.

Effect:
Escape into the realm of the Undead, turning you invisible for 6s (you can still use abilities without revealing yourself).
Decreases your Damage vs. All and Healing Cast by 50%.

PASSIVE_CAPE_KEEPER.name: Berserk
PASSIVE_CAPE_KEEPER.desc:
Condition:
Activates when your Health drops below 80%.

Effect:
Go berserk, increasing all your damage by 40% for 5s (cannot be purged).

PASSIVE_CAPE_MORGANA.name: Mark of the Raven
PASSIVE_CAPE_MORGANA.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you use your third-slot ability.

Effect:
Bless yourself with the Mark of the Raven, reducing your Cast Times and increasing your Auto-Attack Speed by 50% for 5s.

PASSIVE_CAPE_DEMON.name: Opening to Hell
PASSIVE_CAPE_DEMON.desc:
Condition:
Activates when you do an Auto-Attack.

Effect:
Conjure a lava puddle in a 3 radius around the targeted enemy, which lasts 5s.
Deals 55 magical damage (vs. players) / 31.9 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5s.

VANITY_RUBBERBANDING.name: Rubberbanding
VANITY_RUBBERBANDING.desc: Keeps teleporting you back every- Keeps teleporting you back every- Keeps teleporting you back every-

SELF_CLEANSE.name: Cleanse
SELF_CLEANSE.desc: Create a purifying circle with a 4 radius at your feet, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced) from all allies within the circle.

ENERGY_BARRIER.name: Energizing Shield
ENERGY_BARRIER.desc:
Gather ambient energy to gain a Shield, absorbing up to 192 damage (before resistances) for 3s.
Restores 25% of your missing Energy.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.desc:
Release a sonic wave in a cone in front of you, dealing 62 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 35% for 4s.
Decreases damage dealt by 30% (vs. players) / 20% (vs. mobs) for 4s.
Interrupts enemy spell casting.

FLAMESHIELD.name: Inferno Shield
FLAMESHIELD.desc:
Cover yourself with a flaming shield, increasing your damage resistances by 25% for 6s.
Reflects 38% of incoming damage as magical damage.

BLOODLUST.name: Bloodlust
BLOODLUST.desc: Give in to your Bloodlust, restoring 50 Health whenever you deal direct damage within the next 6s (only applies up to 7 times).

SPRINT_CD_REDUCTION.name: Refreshing Sprint
SPRINT_CD_REDUCTION.desc: Start to sprint, increasing your Move Speed by 80% and your Cooldown Rate by 33.3% for 5s.

CLEANSE_DASH.name: Break Free
CLEANSE_DASH.desc:
Dash towards the targeted position.
Removes all Crowd Control Effects (can be used while stunned or silenced).

DODGE.name: Dodge

Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all damage, debuffs, and Crowd Control effects for 0.8s.

CHARGE_SHIELD.name: Shield Charge

ARMORCHAIN.name: Soul Chain

BATTLEFRENZY.name: Battle Frenzy
BATTLEFRENZY.desc:

WEAPON_SILENCE.name: Hush
WEAPON_SILENCE.desc: Call down smothering smoke at a targeted location, silencing all enemies in a 4 radius for 3.3s after 0.45s.

REFLECTAREA.name: Protection of the Fiends
REFLECTAREA.desc:
Create an aura with a 7 radius around you while channeling for 12s (can move while channeling and can't be interrupted).
Reflects 50% of incoming damage to you and up to 9 allies as magical damage.

BERSERK_SPRINT.name: Vengeful Sprint
BERSERK_SPRINT.desc:
Motivate yourself with vengeance, applying two Vengeance Charges on you.
Apply one additional Vengeance Charge for every 20% Health you are missing.

Each Vengeance Charge increases your Move Speed by 25% and your damage by 5% for 5s (stacks up to 5 times).

ELECTRICSHOCK.name: Electric Discharge
ELECTRICSHOCK.desc:
Create an electric pulse around you, expanding for 1.33s to a 11 radius.
Stuns all enemies it touches for 1.5s.
Deals 20.2 magical damage.

FORCESHIELD.name: Force Shield
FORCESHIELD.desc:
Create a Force Shield with a 7 radius around the targeted position lasting 8s.
Increases damage resistances by 25% and Healing Received by 25% for up to 10 allies within the field.

SHOULDERTACKLE.name: Elbow Smash
SHOULDERTACKLE.desc: Dash towards the targeted position, throwing all enemies within a 4 radius of the targeted position in the air for … (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance) on impact.

SPIDER_THREAD.name: Spider's Thread
SPIDER_THREAD.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 3s.

1st Spider's Thread:
Shoot a thread in the targeted direction, dealing 40 magical damage to the first enemy hit.
Enemies who are unmounted will be slowed by 20% for 3s (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).
Hitting an enemy who is not mounted enables the next combo ability.

2nd Hunt Prey:
Dash to the enemy hit by Spider's Thread.

ARMOR_WEB.name: Mythical Web
ARMOR_WEB.desc:
Place a web with a … radius under your feet, lasting 5s (can't be interrupted).
Slows all enemies within it by 35%.
Purges all Move Speed buffs.

Placing a new web on the ground will dissolve all ally webs in a 16 radius around you.

CHARGE_IN.name: Crush Charge
CHARGE_IN.desc:
Dash toward the targeted position (can't be interrupted), knocking all enemies you pass through 15 in the charge direction.
Deals 60 physical damage.

Knocked-back enemies that collide with the environment will be stunned for …CHARGE_IN_COLLISION.stun[0].time.

PURIFYING_SMOKE.name: Purifying Smoke
PURIFYING_SMOKE.desc:
Conjure Purifying Smoke in a 4 radius around the targeted position after 0.4s, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects) from all allies in the smoke.
Purges all buffs of all enemies within the smoke.

REFLECT_CHANNEL.name: Requite
REFLECT_CHANNEL.desc:
Create a magic shield, slowing yourself by 30% while channeling for 99s (can't be interrupted).
Increases your damage resistances by 40%.

Whenever you take damage, the shield shoots a magic orb, silencing the attacker for 2s on impact.
Deals 27 magical damage.

CC_BLOCK.name: Premonition
CC_BLOCK.desc:
Ready yourself, increasing your Move Speed by 45% and becoming immune to Forced Movement effects for 3s.

If you are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed, this effect will be replaced, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and increasing your Move Speed by 1.2 for 4s.
Grants immunity to Stuns, Roots, Slows, and Transformations.

PASSIVE_BALANCE.name: Balanced Mind
PASSIVE_BALANCE.desc:
Increases all your damage and your Healing Cast, by 1.5%.
Increases Defense by 1%.

PASSIVE_ARMOR_BALANCE.name: Balanced Mind
PASSIVE_ARMOR_BALANCE.desc:
Increases all your damage and your Healing Cast, by 4%.
Increases Defense by 2%.

RETALIATE2.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE2.desc:
Conjure a magical barrier, increasing your damage resistances by 20% for 3s.
