HASTE.name: Haste
HASTE.desc: Hasten your attacks, increasing your Auto-Attack Speed by 60% and all damage you deal by 20% for 8s.

OVERSPRINT.name: Rush
OVERSPRINT.desc: Rush into the fight, increasing Move Speed by 1.2 and the duration of your Crowd Control effects by 35% for 3s.

SUMMONER_CD_REDUCTION.name: Meditation
SUMMONER_CD_REDUCTION.desc: Meditate, increasing your Cooldown Rate by 80% while channeling for up to 3s.

AMBUSH.name: Ambush
AMBUSH.desc:
Prepare an ambush, turning yourself invisible for 7s (attacking, using an ability, or interacting with an object will reveal you).
Increases your damage by 5% for every 1s you stay invisible (stacks up to 6 times) the next time you deal damage within 4s after revealing you.

If you move more than 13 away from the cast location you will be revealed.

ASSASSIN_DASH.name: Swift Cut
ASSASSIN_DASH.desc: Dash behind the target enemy and deal 90 physical damage.

SMELLOFBLOOD.name: Mortal Agony
SMELLOFBLOOD.desc:
Release a threatening pulse in a 6 radius around you, increasing all damage you deal by 15% for 4s.
Reveals invisible enemies hit.

Enemies hit below 50% Health will have their damage resistances reduced by 35% for 4s.

STORMSHIELD.name: Electric Field
STORMSHIELD.desc:
Unleash an electric field in a 6 radius around you, lasting 5.5s.
Deals 26 magical damage to all enemies within the field every 0.5s.

DMG_BLINK.name: Raging Blink
DMG_BLINK.desc:
Teleport towards the targeted position (can't teleport through obstacles), increasing all your damage and Healing Cast by 8% for 4.5s (stacks up to 2 times).
Grants immunity to damage and purges for 0.2s.

The ability can be recast again within 4s, increasing its cooldown by 5s.

SMOKEBOMB.name: Smokebomb
SMOKEBOMB.desc:
Drop a Smokebomb at your feet, releasing a cloud with a … radius lasting 5s.
Silences you and all enemies while in the cloud.
Turns you invisible while in the cloud (Auto-Attacks do not reveal you).

LIFESTEALAURA.name: Life Steal Aura
LIFESTEALAURA.desc:
Create a vicious aura with a 7 radius around you, lasting 8s.
Deals magical damage to up to 5 enemies based on your current Health every 1s.

Health: 80% | 60% | 40% | 20% | below 20%
Damage: 16 | 20 | 24 | 28 | 32

Steals 1 (vs. players) / 50% (vs. mobs) of the Health the enemy has lost.

DEATHMARK.name: Mark of Sacrifice
DEATHMARK.desc:
Mark a target, becoming invisible to players, while channeling for 2.25s (can move while channeling and can't be interrupted).

When the channel ends, you dash to the marked target (canceling the channel prevents the dash).
Increases all your damage by 35% for 4s.

ARMOR_CD_RESET.name: Flash of Insight
ARMOR_CD_RESET.desc:
Gain a Flash of Insight, resetting the cooldown of your armor ability.
If the cast is interrupted the cooldown will be halved.

BURNAURA.name: Self Ignition
BURNAURA.desc:
Ignite yourself, dealing 2% true damage (vs. players) / 43.9 magical damage (vs. mobs / mounts) every 0.5s to up to 5 enemies within a 7 radius around you.

Take 2% of your Max Health every 0.5s as true damage.
Decreases your Healing Received by 50%.

The ability can last up to 20s but can be deactivated earlier.

INVISIBLE_WALK.name: Spectral Run
INVISIBLE_WALK.desc:
Take a spectral form, turning yourself invisible while channeling for up to 16.5s (can move while channeling; taking damage ends the channel).
Each 0.5s channeled costs 2% of your Max Energy.

Moving more than 15 decreases all damage you deal by 50% for 3s.

IMMORTAL.name: Immortal
IMMORTAL.desc:
Become Immortal, making it impossible to drop below 1 Health.
Become immune to enemy Transformation effects.
Consumes 2% of your Max Energy every 1s.

The ability can last up to 5s but can be deactivated earlier.

MIST_WALKER.name: Mist Cloud
MIST_WALKER.desc:
Turn into a Mist Cloud with a 7 radius, granting immunity to All Effects and slowing yourself by 30%.
Allies inside the Mist turn invisible. (Attacking, using an ability, or interacting with an object will reveal yourself or allies temporarily).

The ability can last up to 5s but can be deactivated earlier.

AFTER_IMAGE.name: After Image
AFTER_IMAGE.desc:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 6s.

1st After Image:
Dash towards the targeted position, leaving an After Image of yourself at your original position for up to 6s. Moving more than 32 away from the After Image will set this ability on cooldown.

2nd Return to Image:
Teleport to the After Image (cannot teleport through obstacles).

NASTY_WOUNDS.name: Nasty Wounds
NASTY_WOUNDS.desc:
Conjure a swirl of energy in a 5 radius around you, lasting 4s.
Deals 10 magical damage every 0.5s to all enemies within the swirl (this damage cannot be reflected).

Enemies entering the swirl for the first time will have their Healing Received and Healing Cast decreased by 50% for 4s.

DYNAMIC_DEFENSE.name: Dynamic Defense
DYNAMIC_DEFENSE.desc:
React to the targeted enemy or ally, adapting your fighting style for 4s based on the weapon the target is wielding.

If the target is wielding a magic weapon:
Increases your Magic Resistance by 80% and all damage by 10%.

If the target is wielding a physical weapon:
Increases your Armor by 80% and all damage by 10%.

If the target is a mob:
Increases your Defense vs. mobs by 50% and damage vs. mobs by 25%.

BLINDSPOT.name: Blind Spot
BLINDSPOT.desc:
Enter the Blind Spot of your enemy, turning yourself invisible to players and increasing your Move Speed by 60% for 1.5s.

Deals 90 bonus magical damage the next time you deal damage within 3s.

FLARE.name: Flare
FLARE.desc:
Shoot a flare towards the targeted position that grows from 4 to 7.5 over 5s.
Enemies in the area are revealed, cannot become invisible, and have their Cooldown Rate decreased by 50%.

IMMUNEAREA.name: Wings of Fire
IMMUNEAREA.desc:
Conjure a pair of dragon wings to fly through the air, becoming immune to CC.
Creates an area with a 5.5 radius at the landing position for 6s.
While inside the area, enemies outside it cannot affect you, and your damage and cooldown rate are increased by 15%.

WEAPON_SPRINT.name: Burning Momentum
WEAPON_SPRINT.desc:
Gain 4 charges of Burning Momentum.
Each Burning Momentum charge grants 18% movement speed for up to 6s.
Each of the next 4 ability uses refunds 15% of the cooldown of all weapon ability slots, and removes 1 charge of Burning Momentum.

PBAOE_KNOCKBACK.name: Force Field
PBAOE_KNOCKBACK.desc:

ENERGYSHIELD2.desc:

PASSIVE_ARMOR_INCREASED_DAMAGE.name: Aggression

SPRINTEOT.desc:

CHANNELED_RUN.name: Focused Run
CHANNELED_RUN.desc:

ICEBLOCK2.name: Ice Block

LIFESAVIOR.name: Everlasting Spirit
LIFESAVIOR.desc:

BLINK.name: Blink

HELMET_FIREBREATH.name: Firebreath

PURGINGSHIELD2.name: Purging Shield

DELAYED_TELEPORT.name: Delayed Teleport
DELAYED_TELEPORT.desc:

ENERGYFIELD.name: Circle of Inspiration
ENERGYFIELD.desc:

SPELLRUSH.name: Obsessive Burst
SPELLRUSH.desc:
Get a burst of power whenever you cast a spell within the next 10s.
Increases your damage and your Healing Cast by 6% (stacks up to 6 times) for 10s.

FROSTWALK.name: Frost Walk
FROSTWALK.desc:
Freeze the ground below your feet for 5.5s, leaving a trail of frozen ground lasting 2.2s.
Increases your Move Speed by 60%.
Enemies walking over the trail will be slowed by 80%.

PURGE_HELMET.name: Purge

FEAR_AURA.name: Fear Aura
FEAR_AURA.desc:
Create a fiendish aura in a 4 radius around you, lasting 3s.
Any enemy within the aura will flee from you for 2s.

SWAP.name: Position Swap
SWAP.desc:

INNER_CORRUPTION.name: Inner Corruption

If the target is a mob:

LEVITATE.name: Levitate

DEMONWALK.name: Rotten Ground
DEMONWALK.desc:

HYPER_FOCUS.name: Hyper Focus

Create a Ring of Fire with a 5 radius on the ground around you, lasting 3s. Sets all enemies touching it aflame, dealing 140 magical damage over 4s. Burning enemies will flee from you for 1s (mobs flee only once).
